faq.a: No dress codes. No gatekeeping. Just good people, great energy, and a community that's always alive.
Club hire available at the venue subject to availability.

faq.q: Do I need to book the driving range?
faq.a: No booking needed. Our TrackMan driving range is walk-on. Create your free range account, top it up, then scan your QR at the ball machine. Medium bucket $25, Large $30, XLarge $35. Top up $200, get $250 of range credit.

faq.q: How big a group can you host?
faq.a: Built for groups of 12 to 150. Smaller group? Book Social Golf direct: up to three bays, up to 12 guests, book online and turn up ready to play.

faq.q: How many people per simulator bay?
faq.a: Your own TrackMan bay for up to 4.

faq.q: Do you have simulator or lesson packs?
faq.a: Yes. Simulator packs from $100 (Off-Peak Pack, 3 x 1 hour sessions Mon to Fri 7am to 5pm) and PGA lesson packs from $380. Credits land in your account straight away, no membership needed.
21 days of GolfSpace for $199: two PGA lessons, ten TrackMan sessions, range buckets, putting analysis and the full club. No lock-in. No pressure.

faq.q: Who do I talk to about an event?
faq.a: Call us and ask for Hayden Edwards, Head of Community and Events, on 02 8331 6868 or email hayden@golfspace.com.au.
